title: Optimally Selecting Representative Agents from a Metric Space
abstract: arXiv:2608.29097v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies the problem of proportionally fair clustering, where the goal is to select $k$ ``centers'' from a metric space that fairly represent a set of agents who also lie in the metric space. Specifically, we focus on finding a clustering satisfying a fairness property known as the Droop core. In the practical special case in which the set of feasible center locations contains every agent location, the previous best-known result guaranteed a $(1 + \sqrt{2})$-approximation of the Droop core, while the best-known lower bound was $2$. In this paper, we show that this lower bound is tight and that a clustering in the $2$-Droop core always exists. Further, we show that such a clustering can be achieved by only selecting centers from locations in the metric space where an agent resides. translated_title: 从度量空间中最优选择代表性智能体
translated_abstract: 本文研究了比例公平聚类问题，其目标是从度量空间中选取 $k$ 个“中心”，以公平地代表同样位于该度量空间中的一组智能体。具体而言，我们专注于寻找满足一种称为 Droop 核的公平性性质的聚类。在实际的特殊情形中，即可行中心位置的集合包含每个智能体所在的位置时，此前已知的最佳结果保证了对 Droop 核的 $(1 + \sqrt{2})$-近似，而最佳已知的下界为 $2$。在本文中，我们证明该下界是紧的，即 $2$-Droop 核中的聚类总是存在的。此外，我们证明这样的聚类可以通过仅从度量空间中智能体所在的位置选取中心来实现。我们利用 Scarf 定理——该定理保证平衡的不可转移效用博弈具有非空核——来建立这一结果。这一结果具有若干有意义的……
tldr: 本文借助 Scarf 定理证明了在比例公平聚类问题中，仅从智能体所在位置选取中心即可实现 $2$-Droop 核聚类，从而使此前已知的 $2$ 下界达到紧致。
en_tdlr: Using Scarf's theorem, this paper proves that a clustering in the 2-Droop core always exists and can be achieved by selecting centers only from agent locations, making the previously known lower bound of 2 tight.
